name: actionbar
title: ui.actionbar
lead: Shows a line above the hotbar to everyone in the room.

usedIn.quote: ui.actionbar(text, color)            -- the line above the hotbar, to everyone
player.ui.actionbar("Bet 50 · Chips 1200", "light_purple")   -- the line above the hotbar
